name: fix-on-edit
description: Runs your project's linter on each file Claude edits and feeds any errors back so Claude fixes them in the same turn.

command.title: Lint Command
command.description: Lint command with a {file} placeholder, e.g. 'eslint --fix {file}'. Empty = auto-detect by extension.

timeoutMs.title: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the lint subprocess.
